description: This file defines the CustomerOptionService interface, which extends a generic service and provides method signatures for managing customer options within a specific store context, including listing options by store, saving or updating options, and retrieving options by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionService
classes.description: Interface for managing customer options, extending a generic entity service, providing methods to list options by store, save or update options, and retrieve options by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption objects for a given store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption based on store and option code.
